title: DreamScript IR edge
description: One connection between two nodes. An edge is what a reader would trace with a finger from one thing to another.

src.description: Node id the edge leaves. Null means the tail was drawn but its owner could not be decided - the edge then belongs in unresolved_edges.

dst.description: Node id the edge enters. Null carries the same meaning as a null src.

directed.description: True when an arrowhead was drawn. A circuit wire and a UML association are undirected; a flowchart arrow and a state transition are not. Direction is a property of the drawing, not of the diagram type - an undirected line in a flowchart stays undirected here and is repaired in Phase 10.

label.description: Text attached to the edge - the 'yes' on a decision branch, the 'a,b' on a transition. Empty string when unlabelled.

polyline.description: The drawn path as [[x, y], ...] in image pixels, at least two points. Null when the source records connectivity but not geometry.
